correctness.rationale: For m≥3, hub-to-leaf squared distances a>0 and equal leaf separation b>0, the zero-sum distance quadratic form is −b||w||²+((m−1)b/m−2a)s², so negative type iff 0<r=b/a≤rc=2m/(m−1). Euclidean regular-simplex centroid-axis realization and metric boundary r≤2 follow. The Gaussian kernel decomposes into leaf-difference eigenvalue 1−p^r and 2×2 block determinant D=1+(m−1)p^r−mp²>0 by strict weighted AM–GM. Unique weights give M=1+m(1−p)^2/D; derivative has positive prefactor times a bracket whose r dependence has no interior minimum over [0,rc], leaving positive endpoints. At r=rc, H_k(p)=1−(k+1)p+(k+1−p)p^(1+2/k) has H,H′,H″ all zero at p=1 and H‴<0 for 0<p<1, proving strict positivity at every scale. Exact Taylor expansions give generic limit1, critical (m+1)/2+(m+1)at/6 and δ-transition 1+mτ/(m−1+rcτ). Fresh symbolic expansions were checked independently at m=3,4,5,7. No inference of a general negative-type monotonicity theorem; only nonmetric 2<r≤rc is claimed as new.
